diagnostics.title: Webhook log exporter disabled (invalid configuration)
diagnostics.summary: A request-log webhook exporter could not be built from its configuration and has been disabled, so its request logs are NOT delivered. This is a config problem surfaced at boot, not a transient delivery failure.
diagnostics.action: Fix the named webhook exporter's configuration (URL, auth header, or projection) and restart to re-enable delivery.

diagnostics.title: Webhook log delivery returned non-2xx (log dropped)
diagnostics.summary: A request-log webhook delivery got a non-2xx response from the sink, so that one log line was dropped (deliveries are fire-and-forget and never retried). This can recur per request when a sink is unhealthy, so it is logged at debug.
diagnostics.action: If logs are being lost, check the webhook sink's health and the delivery counters. `WEBHOOK_LOGS_DROPPED_TOTAL` tracks the volume.

diagnostics.title: Webhook log delivery transport error (log dropped)
diagnostics.summary: A request-log webhook delivery failed with a transport error (connection/timeout/DNS), so that one log line was dropped. Deliveries are fire-and-forget and never retried; this can recur per request when a sink is unreachable, so it is logged at debug.
diagnostics.action: If logs are being lost, check the webhook sink's reachability and the delivery counters. `WEBHOOK_LOGS_DROPPED_TOTAL` tracks the volume.
